name: Teysa's uncle
description: A more recent member of the Obzedat whose preserved body Teysa greets in the chamber; he told her the bodies were burnt.

timeline.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
